statements.quote: In addition to the temporal dataset, we also collected information about participants’ characteristics. deposits.notes: Preregistration titled 'How Humans Co-Create With AI: Effects on Writing Diversity', registered 2025-11-03. The paper-provided anonymous view_only URL permits reading without an account, although the registration metadata says public=false; public here means accessible using the link printed in the paper. This is a registration, not a project node: https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/3u8tq/?view_only=e1a8044dd5044bc59dd0a7d8f3fca3c2 and its children endpoint returned 404, not evidence of a dead deposit. https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/3u8tq/files/osfstorage/?view_only=e1a8044dd5044bc59dd0a7d8f3fca3c2 returned HTTP 200 with total=0. The correct https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/3u8tq/?view_only=e1a8044dd5044bc59dd0a7d8f3fca3c2 returned HTTP 200 and the full preregistration responses. Under that registration endpoint, files/osfstorage/, children/, linked_nodes/, linked_registrations/, resources/, and wikis/ each returned HTTP 200, total=0, and no next page. files/ returned only the osfstorage provider. Metadata explicitly has has_data=false, has_analytic_code=false, has_materials=false, has_papers=false, and has_supplements=false. The closest contents category is materials_only because the preregistration is inline text, not an uploaded material file. Planned treatment conditions and target sample size are described, but no observed participant assignments, outcome scores, story texts, interaction logs, or analysis scripts are deposited. The license relationship (licenses/563c1cf88c5e4a3877f9e96a/ with the same view_only parameter) returned HTTP 200 and CC BY 4.0. Preregistration q17 discusses pairwise scoring and a subsampling robustness check for metrics such as compression ratio, but provides neither executable implementation nor data sufficient to resolve the form's missing statistics.

deposits.license: CC BY 4.0; article license confirmed on the arXiv landing page and in DataCite metadata for 10.48550/arXiv.2604.03529.
deposits.notes: Found through the arXiv landing page's TeX Source link. Downloaded the 3,224,257-byte gzip/tar archive into memory and enumerated all 24 regular files without extracting to disk. It contains 00README.json, bib.bib, main.tex, and 21 figure assets (20 PNGs and one PDF), including experiment instructions, attention checks, interfaces, and survey screenshots. main.tex was read for availability/link statements; it repeats the same OSF preregistration. No participant-data file or analysis script was identified. Figures and manuscript tables contain published aggregate results, not individual observations. has_arm_assignment and has_outcome_scores refer to observed participant records; merely describing arms and printing aggregate effects does not satisfy those fields.

Related lead, explicitly not mapped to S1: 'How Humans Co-Create With AI: Effects on Writing Diversity (Study 2)', DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/YDVQT, by Nathan Jo and Manish Raghavan. Found by DataCite searches for the original preregistration title and for 'Nathan Jo'. Registered 2026-09-16, after the source paper; the planned task is a product pitch with 400 participants, whereas form S1 concerns 200 recruited short-story writers. Registration response 344-4 states: 'Data does not yet exist. No part of the data that will be used for this analysis plan exists, and no part will be generated until after this plan is registered.' This describes the registration date, not evidence that data still do not exist today. The landing page and https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/ydvqt/ returned HTTP 200, public=true, embargoed=false. nodes/ydvqt/ and nodes/ydvqt/children/ returned 404 because this identifier is a registration; nodes/ydvqt/files/osfstorage/ returned HTTP 200, total=0. The registration's files/osfstorage/, children/, linked_nodes/, linked_registrations/, and resources/ endpoints each returned HTTP 200, total=0. files/ lists only osfstorage. Metadata reports no data, analytic code, materials, papers, or supplements. n_files counts OSF storage files. The separate wikis/ endpoint lists one Home wiki (q2phj; metadata size 41 bytes), but https://api.osf.io/v2/wikis/q2phj/content/ returned HTTP 200 with an empty, zero-byte response. This is not a dataset. The linked underlying Study 2 project https://osf.io/xv9sa/ returned an HTTP 200 application shell, while https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/xv9sa/ returned HTTP 401 'Authentication credentials were not provided'; its access is account_required and inspection stopped. No access request or login was attempted. This related follow-up and its restricted parent do not establish a data deposit or a restriction for S1.

notes: Checked 2026-10-09 America/New_York (2026-10-10 UTC) using Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 and no authentication. Read the entire 82,158-character markdown conversion, including all appendices A-C of the 30-page arXiv v1 source paper, and checked relevant PDF text/footnotes with PyMuPDF. Quotes preserve source characters with only layout whitespace normalized; quotations spanning pages omit running page numbers/footers. No explicit data-sharing, code-release, supplementary-data-deposit, or available-on-request statement was found. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are empty. Statements therefore include preregistration, data-collection descriptions, and locators for materials/results embedded in the paper; they must not be read as promises of data release. The paper-linked OSF record is readable anonymously and has no files. The public article source archive contains materials and printed aggregate results. No participant or participant-linked output table was found, so no row/column check was possible. None of final.open_items can be computed from these deposits: the exact randomized/analyzed counts and exclusion flow; exact AI-T MiniLM mean; participant-level means, SDs and SEs; the implemented compression-ratio/NGDS scores; first-draft comparator/sample definitions; discrepant significance results; the intended conditional analysis; or numerical uncertainty/error-bar definitions. The later Study 2 registration is retained as a related search lead and must not be substituted for S1. Its private underlying project does not justify classifying S1 as restricted. All explicit external PDF links were requested: the OSF URL is documented in its deposit; other link checks were https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03529v1 -> HTTP 200; https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L12-v2 -> HTTP 200; https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 -> HTTP 200; https://huggingface.co/spaces/mteb/leaderboard -> HTTP 200; https://nymag.com/intelligencer/article/ai-generated-content-internet-online-slop-spam.html -> HTTP 200; https://www.nytimes.com/2024/07/24/opinion/ai-annoying-future.html -> HTTP 403; https://aclanthology.org/2022.repl4nlp-1.26/ -> HTTP 200. The Hugging Face links are generic model/benchmark resources and the three bibliography links concern other publications, not this study's data. The NYTimes HTTP 403 response was a bot/JavaScript check and was not bypassed. Publisher/version checks: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03529 -> HTTP 200; version history lists only v1 dated 2026-04-04, with PDF/HTML/TeX source links and no direct supplementary dataset link. https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/68591 -> HTTP 200; its Project Page points to https://genaicreativity.org/icml2026/files/19/19_paper.pdf -> HTTP 200 (2,837,599 bytes, 26 pages), inspected in memory for all external links and data/code/material/preregistration statements.
